```yaml
name: Cleanup Neon Preview Branch

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  cleanup-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
      NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
      PR_HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Delete Neon preview branch
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="${PR_HEAD_REF}"
          PROJECT_ID="${NEON_PROJECT_ID}"
          API_URL="https://api.neon.tech/v1/projects/${PROJECT_ID}/branches/${BRANCH_NAME}"
          echo "Deleting Neon branch: ${BRANCH_NAME}"
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X DELETE \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${NEON_API_KEY}" \
            "${API_URL}")
          if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 204 ]; then
            echo "Neon branch '${BRANCH_NAME}' deleted successfully."
          else
            echo "Failed to delete Neon branch '${BRANCH_NAME}'. HTTP status: ${RESPONSE}"
            exit 1
          fi
```
